newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore electronics sector seen up 10-15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore electronics sector seen up 10-15 pct.

text.p: Singapore electronic sector is seen growing 10 to 15 percent in 1997, said the Economic Development Board (EDB) on Monday.
"In 1997, we see 10 to 15 percent in output growth for the electronic sector," said Liow Voon Kheong, director of electronics with the EDB, at a briefing for reporters.
He said most companies saw that their second half performance should be better than the first half.
EDB officials said the nine percent growth in 1996 was the first time in five years that the industry in Singapore recorded single digit growth.
